newsitem.title: USA: First USA Paymentech files for share offer.
newsitem.headline: First USA Paymentech files for share offer.

text.p: First USA Paymentech Inc said on Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for two separate public offerings of 2.8 million primary and four million secondary shares of common stock.

The 2.8 million shares were being issued and sold by Paymentech and the four million secondary shares were being sold by First USA Inc, which now owns about 77 percent of Paymentech's outstanding stock, the company said.
After the offer, First USA expected to own about 59 percent of the common stock of Paymentech, or about 57 percent if underwriters over-allotment options were fully exercised, the company said.

Assuming a $37 per Paymentech share offering price, Paymentech expected to receive about $98.4 million, and First USA would receive net proceeds of about $141.3 million, the company said. Paymentech closed at $37 on November 7.

Paymentech said it would use proceeds for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment. First USA would also use proceeds for general corporate purposes, including marketing and expanding the core credit card business with other financial products, the company said.
Merrill Lynch & Co would be the lead underwriter in the United States and Canada and Merrill Lynch International Limited would be the lead international manager, it said.
